---
{
  "layout": "archive",
  "permalink": "/publications/",
  "author_profile": true
}
---
<!-- Generated by sync-publications.py; edit publications.yaml. -->

<h3 class="pub-section">Preprints</h3>
{% assign entries = site.publications | where: "pubtype", "preprint" | sort: "number" %}
<ol class="pub-list" start="1">
{% for post in entries %}
  {% include pub-item.html post=post %}
{% endfor %}
</ol>
